title: Navy officer portrait in khaki uniform and cap on BUPERS photograph submission form, 1959
description: Black-and-white portrait of a U.S. Navy officer wearing a combination cap and khaki uniform with collar insignia and ribbons, attached over a form titled 'Instructions for Submission of Photograph in Accordance with Article B-2210 BuPers Manual'. Typed fields list rank 'W-4', corps 'CHPHOT' and 'Date photograph was taken: 8/25/59'. The sheet is annotated 'BUPERS / FILE JACKET'.
